title: FitPlate DesignSpec
description: A design candidate submitted against a frozen TaskSpec. A DesignSpec may only choose within the freedoms the task grants: plate dimensions the task marks editable, the device center inside the allowed ranges, and rotation 0. It cannot carry hole positions, environment objects, scripts, expressions or file paths -- 'additionalProperties: false' makes every such field an unknown-field rejection instead of a silently ignored suggestion. Locked-value changes, a stale task_revision and out-of-range values are refused by geometry/fitplate/schema.py (LOCKED_CONSTRAINT_CHANGED / STALE_INPUT / INVALID_SPEC).

plate.description: Only the dimensions the task marks editable may be chosen; a locked dimension may be restated only with the frozen value. Every editable dimension must be present (no silent default).

sensor_pose.description: Device center in world X/Y on the plate plane; the device seats on the plate top face. Rotation must be a value the task allows (version 1.0: 0 only).

note.description: Free-text rationale for this candidate. Never used as acceptance evidence.
